summary: Stage A recipe sync: only ucx-rocm drifted, so pack/model-transfer/Dockerfile bumps NIXL_ROCM_UCX_REF from v1.22.0 to the stable openucx/ucx release tag v1.23.0 (non-prerelease, numeric SemVer upgrade verified as ucx_rocm.target_ref in kv-transfer-preflight-report.json). All other recipe pins stay put: NIXL_VERSION 1.5.2 with NIXL_ROCM_VERSION 1.5.2 and NIXL_ROCM_REF v1.5.2 aligned to the staged nixl-rocm pyproject.toml [project].version 1.5.2, HIXL_COMMIT held at gpustack/runner VLLM_HIXL_COMMIT 60dbe9d1d7d9a7eef04bc3dbf84edbad2188230a with patches/hixl/001_channel_generation.patch byte-identical to runner's channel-generation patch, Mooncake MOONCAKE_VERSION 0.3.14 already admitted by all four release guards plus the explicit 0.3.14 arm of the fifth context_manager.cpp block, and MODELEXPRESS_VERSION v0.8.0 matching the staged Cargo.toml [workspace.package].version 0.8.0 (no bump, no docker buildx builder rerun). stage_b_flags are all false and stage: recipe_sync with image_published: false, so pkg/worker/settings/value.go, value_test.go, model_deployment_transfer_test.go, docs/reference/settings.md, docs/modules/model-delivery/remote.md and deploy/gpustack-operator/chart/** are untouched, and kv-cache-backend-image remains held at gpustack/mirrored-mooncake:0.3.13.post1-cpu per .auto-sync/setting-image-holds.json even though 0.3.14-cpu is published.
